system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
## Project Kestrel — Buyer review

The Seller’s assertions that its positions are market-standard, agreed at principal level and final are not evidence of Wattlebridge’s approval. In particular, **no written authority from Amelia Frost has been given** for either the 20% general warranty cap or the 18-month claims period.

| Issue | Seller’s position | Buyer should want | Recommendation and reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001: General liability cap** | 20% of price, or **AUD 4.8m**, for general warranty claims. | **25%, or AUD 6m**. The 20% fallback requires Amelia’s prior written authority identifying the draft. | **Counter at AUD 6m; do not accept the fallback without authority.** It is below the playbook starting position and has not been approved. |
| **SPA-N-002: De minimis & basket** | Claims must exceed **AUD 25,000** individually and **AUD 250,000** in aggregate; only the excess is recoverable. | **AUD 5,000** de minimis and **AUD 50,000** aggregate basket, with liability from the first dollar once exceeded. | **Replace both thresholds and make the basket tipping.** The Seller’s formulation excludes smaller losses and deducts the basket. |
| **SPA-N-003: General claims time limit** | Notice within **18 months** after Completion; limitations apply to all claims unless expressly stated otherwise. | **24 months** for general warranty claims; 18 months only with Amelia’s written approval. Expressly preserve separate category periods. | **Counter at 24 months and remove the blanket override.** Neither the shortened period nor its extension to other claims is authorised. |
| **SPA-N-004: Fundamental/Title regime** | Capacity and title warranties share the general cap and time limit. | Separate regime: **100% of price cap**, at least **six years**, outside the general basket, de minimis and knowledge bar. | **Create an express separate regime.** General warranty restrictions are inappropriate for ownership and authority risk. |
| **SPA-N-005: Fraud carve-out** | Caps, limitations, exclusive remedies and non-reliance apply to all claims. | Carve **fraud, wilful concealment and deliberate misconduct** out of all caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies and non-reliance, to the maximum extent enforceable. | **Insert an overriding carve-out in every relevant provision.** The proposed blanket wording could otherwise restrict recourse for serious misconduct; this protection cannot be waived. |
| **SPA-N-006: Disclosure scope** | Entire data room, accounts, statutory registers and public records are generally disclosed. | Only **specific, fair disclosure** against the relevant warranties; no whole-data-room, public-register or prudent-search deemed disclosure. | **Delete the general deemed disclosures and review each specific disclosure.** Mere availability of documents is not sufficiently targeted disclosure. |
| **SPA-N-007: Buyer knowledge qualifier** | No claim for matters known to Buyer or advisers, including matters discoverable in the data room or public records. | Delete the blanket exclusion. Any knowledge qualifier must use **named seller knowledge persons and reasonable enquiry**, and never excuse title, capacity, fraud or a specific indemnity. | **Delete clause 8.3 as drafted.** It converts actual and deemed buyer knowledge into an overly broad bar to claims. |
| **SPA-N-008: Bluefen consent** | Reasonable endeavours; condition satisfied on delivery of written consent. No final consent or evidence of satisfied conditions is included. | **Effective consent and evidence that its conditions are satisfied before Completion.** | **Make both a Completion condition.** Delivery alone does not establish an effective, unconditional consent for a customer representing about 30% of FY26 revenue. |
| **SPA-N-009: Riverlark facility** | Approximately **AUD 3.2m** outstanding; security release to follow Completion. No repayment or final discharge is included. | Current payout statement, **direct repayment from Completion funds**, and effective security releases. A post-Completion release requires an **irrevocable undertaking and Amelia’s approval**. | **Revise the funds flow and closing deliverables; obtain current lender documents.** Debt-free/cash-free completion requires repayment and a reliable release mechanism. |
| **SPA-N-010: Employee bonuses** | Conditional **AUD 420,000** bonuses omitted from the funds flow; on-costs not stated. | A specific funds-flow line item or Seller funding for **AUD 420,000 plus triggered on-costs**, subject to confirming the applicable conditions. | **Identify, calculate and fund the obligation expressly.** The current flow silently omits it and may also omit payroll-related costs. |
| **SPA-N-011: Ironquay IP indemnity** | Indemnity limited to the SOW3 payment; Seller says it is adequate. DD-010 records **AUD 180,000 open**, without independent verification of non-payment. | Broader indemnity for the Ironquay IP risk, preserving the **SOW3 cure**; obtain payment evidence and a confirmatory assignment or other effective ownership assurance. | **Broaden the indemnity and verify the cure.** Cleared payment is a condition of transfer, but neither payment nor non-payment is independently established. |
| **SPA-N-012: Export/privacy incident** | Preliminary operational matter, said not to be expected to be material. Access, scope and notification duty remain unestablished. | Preserve logs and evidence, investigate access and scope, and require updates; assess notification and remediation as facts develop. | **Require a documented investigation and continuing updates.** Do not assume a confirmed breach, harm, notification duty or numeric loss or demand. |
| **SPA-N-013: Sandbar renewals** | **AUD 330,000** aggregate described as ordinary-course operating costs. | Assess DD-008 and DD-011 together for timing, scope, accrual, termination and unavoidable commitment. | **Investigate before allocating the cost.** Neither ordinary-course treatment nor automatic Debt classification or a price deduction is established. |
| **SPA-N-014: Category separation** | All-claims limitations apply unless expressly excepted; Seller also places Tax and IP under the general regime. | Keep **Title, Tax, IP, payment and covenant** categories separate, with express applicable remedies and limitations and no hidden general-regime override. | **Rewrite the hierarchy and cross-references.** Broad all-claims language could silently override separately negotiated protections. |
| **SPA-N-015: Title verification** | DD-012 company share register records Seller as holder of 100%. | Independent evidence of **title, ownership, encumbrances and authority**, in addition to reviewing DD-012. | **Obtain and reconcile independent verification before Completion.** The supplied internal register is a source, not independent proof. |
| **SPA-N-016: Tax/IP open terms** | Seller treats tax and IP warranties as settled under the general regime. | **Tax and IP remain open**, with their respective scope, remedies and limitations negotiated separately; do not assume unlimited liability. | **Mark both categories open and reserve the Buyer’s position.** No resolution or unlimited-liability agreement has been established. |

**Other disclosure points:** DD-007 identifies a lease **notification** obligation, not a landlord consent requirement. DD-009 identifies an **assignment restriction**, not a consent requirement merely because the shares are sold. Confirm the relevant obligations without overstating either document.
=== END ADVICE ===
